preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero. This will cause all transfers from non-owner addresses to fail because the _transfer function checks if amount <= _maxTxAmount when sender != owner() && recipient != owner(). This effectively stops all user transactions while allowing the owner to continue transferring tokens.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxPercent() that controls the _maxTxAmount variable. When set to zero, the _transfer() function will revert for any non-zero transfer where neither sender nor recipient is the owner. This allows the owner to freeze all user transactions while maintaining their own ability to transfer tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero, effectively freezing all non-owner transfers.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Find the current owner address of the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setMaxTxPercent(0) on the target contract
4. Verify that _maxTxAmount is now zero
